$comment: INTERIM registry (v0). Phase 2 work package 1 needs a referent so that rule files can be checked for dangling indicator IDs and for evidence-class diversity (CONF-002). The vocabulary is taken verbatim from the Phase 1 seed corpus, which already commits to these names in its expected_indicators. Work package 2 replaces this with proper indicator families carrying extraction contracts; work package 3 replaces the NEGATIVE half with the authored negative-indicator library (G-07). Nothing here defines HOW an indicator is detected — only that it exists, what evidence class it belongs to, and how much weight it may carry alone.
amended: 2026-08-28 — 13 positive and 3 negative indicators added for the rules the RESEARCH-006 manual retrieval reconciliation made publishable (executive impersonation, accessibility/APK/wallet-connect device actions, task-app deposit/blocked-withdrawal, screen-share, celebrity impersonation), plus device-action and app-store guards. Evidence-class/strength assignments remain HEURISTIC programme judgements; source_basis points at the manually-retrieved source. | 2026-08-28 — NEGATIVE (SUPPRESSIVE) indicators MIGRATED OUT to knowledge/indicators/negative-indicator-library-v1.json (WP3, G-07). This file now holds POSITIVE indicators only. Loaders merge the library's negatives back into the indicator namespace for ID/polarity resolution.
superseded_by: knowledge/indicators/indicator-families-v1.json (Phase 2 WP2, WRITTEN 2026-08-29). The families file ORGANISES these positive indicators into 28 extraction families; it does NOT change any indicator id/polarity/evidence_class/strength here — this registry remains the source of truth for indicator definitions. See KB-002.
provenance: DERIVED from knowledge/seed-data/seed-corpus-v1.json. Evidence-class and strength assignments are HEURISTIC programme judgements, not source-published values.

evidence_classes.PRETEXT: The stated reason for contact — the story that frames the request
evidence_classes.PRESSURE: Coercion, urgency, threat, secrecy or discouragement of verification
evidence_classes.IDENTITY_CLAIM: An assertion about who the sender is
evidence_classes.CREDENTIAL_ACTION: A request for a secret: OTP, PIN, CVV, card number, verification code
evidence_classes.PAYMENT_ACTION: A request to move money, scan a QR, or authorise a transfer
evidence_classes.DEVICE_ACTION: A request to change device or account state: link a device, install, grant a permission, dial a code
evidence_classes.FINANCIAL_CLAIM: An assertion about returns, guarantees or risk
evidence_classes.CHANNEL_ARTIFACT: A structural property of the message itself: link, shortened URL, lookalike domain, QR image
evidence_classes.SUPPRESSIVE: Negative indicator — evidence that a message is legitimate, or that a positive indicator has been misread

strength_scale.WEAK: Common in legitimate traffic. MUST NOT support a finding alone (RP p.13, CONF-002).
strength_scale.MODERATE: Meaningful but not decisive; requires corroboration from another evidence class.
strength_scale.STRONG: Rare in legitimate traffic, but still subject to the composite requirement — no single indicator publishes a finding.

indicators.description: Threat that an account will be blocked, frozen or suspended
Threat of arrest or detention
Sender claims to be law enforcement, a regulator or a government official
Sender claims to represent a bank or payment operator
An innocuous-sounding reason offered for a technically consequential action
Sender claims to be a family member or close contact
Request for a full card number
Request for a CVV
Request that the recipient disclose an OTP. Distinct from an OTP being delivered — see OTP_DELIVERED_NOT_REQUESTED.
Request to share a device-linking code or scan a linking QR
Recipient is steered away from checking with an official channel
Content imitates a platform's media preview to bait a click
Sender presents as a known contact from an unrecognised account
Unusually high investment returns mentioned
Payment demanded now, framed as avoiding a consequence
Message solicits an investment
Recipient is instructed not to involve family or lawyers. Encodes SRC-012's own wording, not the paraphrase 'secrecy' (D6).
Message concerns employment or a job offer
Employment or income presented as guaranteed
KYC cited as the reason for contact. Legitimate institutions also reference KYC — weak alone by design (CONF-002).
Recipient is accused of a crime — money laundering, drug trafficking, cybercrime
Message contains a URL
Domain closely imitates a known brand or institution
A consequence is stated without threat or coercion — routine in legitimate service messages
Sender explains contact from an unfamiliar number
A parcel, customs or delivery issue is the stated reason for contact
Message concerns a payment, without itself demanding one
Recipient is asked to make a payment
A QR code is attached or referenced
Recipient is asked to scan a QR code
An authorising action is framed as necessary to RECEIVE money. CERT-In states categorically that no UPI PIN or OTP is needed to receive.
Returns presented as assured or guaranteed
Investment risk explicitly denied — 'zero risk'
Limited slots, limited time, limited availability
Recipient is asked to keep the interaction secret
URL uses a shortening service, concealing its destination
Threat that a service will be disconnected or suspended
Curiosity bait — 'is this you in this video?'
Offer to trade or hold funds on the recipient's behalf. SEBI: advisers must not handle client funds.
Message trades on an existing relationship
An offer arrives without the recipient having asked
A fee, deposit or registration charge demanded before a promised benefit

Recipient is asked to dial a USSD or short code, which can silently enable call forwarding. Added during WP1 validation: the seed corpus defines the negative NO_CODE_DIAL_REQUEST but never the positive, because it holds no malicious USSD case — TL-TEL-001 is UNSUPPORTED, so no case was authored for it. A benign guard existed with nothing to guard against.
Recipient is prompted to enter a UPI PIN
Generic urgency. RP p.13: 'One weak indicator such as urgency should not be enough on its own.'
A specific short deadline is imposed
An action is requested without a clear stated purpose
The reason for contact is unspecific
Verification cited as the reason for contact
Recipient is directed to a page or flow that captures credentials under a verification framing
Sender claims to be a senior executive (CEO/CFO/'boss') or a regulator issuing instructions to staff. Added 2026-08-28 for TL-AUTH-003.
Recipient is asked to grant an Android Accessibility permission out of context, which grants screen-reading and input-injection control. Added 2026-08-28 for TL-MAL-002.
Recipient is asked to install an APK or app from a link/message rather than an official store. Added 2026-08-28 for TL-MAL-002 / TL-MAL-001.
Prompt to install an app from an untrusted/non-store source delivered via SMS, chat or social link. Added 2026-08-28 for TL-MAL-001 (iOS config-profile clause excluded — unsupported).
An app or service impersonates a trusted brand to induce installation or a permission grant. Added 2026-08-28.
Recipient is asked to connect/link a crypto wallet to a site or app, which can approve asset transfers. Added 2026-08-28 for TL-CRYP-001.
Recipient is sent to a fake 'verification' website that harvests credentials or wallet approvals. Added 2026-08-28.
Contact is moved off the originating platform to WhatsApp/Telegram to continue the approach. Added 2026-08-28 for TL-CRYP-001.
Easy-income / task-completion / part-time earning lure. Added 2026-08-28 for TL-JOB-003.
Recipient is asked to deposit/invest money to unlock displayed earnings or a larger commission. Added 2026-08-28 for TL-JOB-003.
A withdrawal is frozen/denied unless a further fee, tax or top-up is paid. The discriminating step of the task-app scam. Added 2026-08-28 for TL-JOB-003.
Recipient is asked to install a screen-sharing/remote-control app (AnyDesk, TeamViewer, AirDroid) during a banking interaction. Added 2026-08-28 for TL-MAL-003.
A public figure/celebrity is impersonated or falsely shown endorsing an investment. Added 2026-08-28 for TL-INV-003 (deepfake mechanism excluded — unsupported).
